title: Decide if CCPA opt-out cascading behavior needs to be updated
body:
Let's carefully document the cascading effects of opting out of accounts metrics.

I think this should just be: opting out of FxA metrics also opts you out of all FxA RP metrics.

I don't think opting out of FxA metrics should opt out of desktop/mobile client telemetry.

I also don't think opting out of desktop/mobile client telemetry should opt out of FxA metrics.

But we'll need to confirm all this with legal and privacy.



┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://jira.mozilla.com/browse/FXA-2933)
┆Issue Number: FXA-2933
